message: オーガール

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Synn-chan.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san?」
With the extraordinary student assembly wrapping up without a hitch, KiraFes has finally kicked into high gear.
What started out as a vague concept is taking concrete shape day by day, with new proposals being decided one after another.
Just as I was about to share the news with everyone in the shopping district, I unexpectedly ran into Helena-san.
...Could she be going around explaining things to the volunteers ahead of us on the Student Council?

name: Helena
message: 「Saturday afternoons are so exciting~~」

name: Helena
message: 「Yet with a two-day weekend, your heart doesn't leap like this... Funny, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I kind of get what you mean.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though we have classes all morning, Saturday feels way more thrilling than Sunday.」

name: Helena
message: 「And that excitement will keep right on going until KiraFes.」

name: Synn
message: 「I get that too. Though I can't really put it into words...」

name: Helena
message: 「As long as you get it by feel as president, Synn-chan, it's totally fine! Go for it with a bang!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Also, I haven't told anyone a thing, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, since we went to the trouble of running into each other, it'd be a waste to just stand here chatting.」

name: Helena
message: 「Come along now. There's a sweets shop I'd love to recommend.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see, something on the menu under 100 yen...」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nothing!? Why?! That's enough to live like a king at a penny candy store!!」

name: Helena
message: 「Hey now! At times like this, let your elders save face and treat you.」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Are you sure? Well then, I won't hold back and I'll order.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, boys need to eat hearty. Anyone who acts all cool and refuses sweets is disqualified!」

name: Waitress
message: 「Thank you for waiting~~」
And then, plate after plate of cake is brought out.

name: Synn
message: 「...Delicious!」

name: Helena
message: 「U-fu-fu\s04 Getting to enjoy tea with Synn-chan is one of the perks of being chairwoman, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good?」

name: Helena
message: 「Why, you ask? Because academy staff shouldn't be dining with specific students.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious...」

name: Helena
message: 「I know it sounds stuffy, but that's that and this is this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious.」

name: Helena
message: 「Jeez, keep this a secret from Ria, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Did sweets he ain't used to eatin' poison him or somethin'? Synn-sama's speech center is totally fried.」

name: Paqy
message: 「How the hell are you holdin' a normal conversation with him like that?」

name: Helena
message: 「Foh-foh-foh-foh, I ain't the Chairwoman just for show, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「Good?」

name: Helena
message: 「Right. I'm strictly an alumna of the Student Council, not an active member.」

name: Helena
message: 「My help only goes as far as getting permission for the KiraFes from the faculty.」

name: Helena
message: 「Telling the folks in the shopping district is your job, Synn-chan.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Delicious...」

name: Helena
message: 「Whaaat? Isn't it a little too early to be thanking me?」

name: Helena
message: 「The Chairwoman won't be helping any further than this. From here on, the Student Council has to think and act on its own, okay?」

name: Helena
message: 「I'll take responsibility. Don't worry--do everything you want to do, and go all out.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ahh, even I get it. For all her talk, Helena's got Synn-sama's back.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, did I talk a bit too much?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Helena
message: 「Alright, thanks for the meal. Once you grow up into a dashing man, Synn-chan, you can treat me next time.」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my? That car is--」

name: Riesling
message: 「So it really is you, Helena.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, Tamiko-chan\s04 What are you doing right in the middle of the shopping district?」

name: Riesling
message: 「I have modified the vehicle-mounted Doppler radar and am currently testing it.」

name: Synn
message: 「Good?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Good day to you.」

name: Riesling
message: 「As you have surmised, this radar will doubtless further improve milady's survival rate.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, Tamiko-chan. I was buying a little souvenir for our homebody librarian♪」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! The highest-calorie sweets in Ryuusei Town♪」

name: Helena
message: 「If you're free, why don't you drop by and show your face too? Melilot would be delighted.」

name: Riesling
message: 「...Understood. I shall escort you to the academy while conducting a test run.」

name: Helena
message: 「Lucky♪ Want a ride too, Synn-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Is that so. Please continue to look after milady in the future.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Now then, excuse me--」

name: Helena
message: 「See ya♪ Oh, Paa-chan, I'm leaving the cleanup to you!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez, what a handful.」

name: Synn
message: 「Guhah!! H-Huh? Thank goodness... my voice is back to normal.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ho... Dodging people cleanly without even hitting the brakes.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Nice driving technique. That butler's gotta have a Class A license for sure.」

name: Synn
message: 「They left...」

name: Synn
message: 「I thought I was no match for Ria-senpai, but I'm even less of a match for Helena-san.」

name: Synn
message: 「I did see a dark aura at the end there, but she gave me a great pep talk.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ain't nothing dark about it. That right there is genuine friendship.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When you're Helena's age, Synn-sama, make sure you've got friends like that too, alright?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, and for that to happen, first I have to do my absolute best at KiraFes!」
